definitions.explanation: A difference or contradiction between two things that should match. Used for statements, records, or accounts that don't align.
A situation where people have different views or opinions on something.

examples.japanese: ⟦{証言|しょうげん}→証言：11088_shougen⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{食|く}い{違|ちが}い⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: There are discrepancies in the testimony.

examples.japanese: ⟦{数字|すうじ}→数字：03361_suuji⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{食|く}い{違|ちが}い⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{確認|かくにん}する→確認する：25332_kakuninsuru⟧。
examples.english: Confirm the discrepancy in the numbers.

examples.japanese: ⟦{記録|きろく}→記録：02490_kiroku⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{実際|じっさい}→実際：02502_jissai⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{数|かず}→数：00204_kazu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{食|く}い{違|ちが}い⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦あった→ある：00006_aru⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧で、⟦{調査|ちょうさ}→調査：03489_chousa⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{始|はじ}まった→始まる：00841_hajimaru⟧。
examples.english: There was a discrepancy between the records and the actual count, so an investigation began.

examples.japanese: ⟦{方針|ほうしん}→方針：04871_houshin⟧をめぐって{食|く}い{違|ちが}い⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{生|しょう}じた→生じる：02118_shoujiru⟧。
examples.english: A disagreement arose over the policy.

examples.japanese: ⟦{両者|りょうしゃ}→両者：11357_ryousha⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{間|あいだ}→間：00914_aida⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{根本的|こんぽんてき}→根本的：17920_konponteki⟧な{食|く}い{違|ちが}い⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦あり→ある：00006_aru⟧、⟦{解決|かいけつ}→解決：00136_kaiketsu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{難|むずか}しい→難しい：00517_muzukashii⟧。
examples.english: There's a fundamental disagreement between the two parties, making resolution difficult.

notes:
{食|く}い{違|ちが}い is the noun form of the verb ⟦{食|く}い{違|ちが}う→食い違う：16321_kuichigau⟧ (to not match, to be at odds). It describes situations where things that should align — statements, numbers, opinions — do not.

FORMS:
{食|く}い (stem of ⟦{食|く}う→食う：02657_kuu⟧, to bite) + ⟦{違|ちが}い→違い：03432_chigai⟧ (difference) — the image is of teeth not meshing properly.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {食|く}い{違|ちが}い⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧: there is a discrepancy
- {食|く}い{違|ちが}い⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{生|しょう}じる→生じる：02118_shoujiru⟧: a discrepancy arises
- ⟦{意見|いけん}→意見：01303_iken⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{食|く}い{違|ちが}い: difference of opinion
- ⟦{証言|しょうげん}→証言：11088_shougen⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{食|く}い{違|ちが}い: discrepancy in testimony
- {食|く}い{違|ちが}い⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{解消|かいしょう}する→解消する：21324_kaishousuru⟧: to resolve a discrepancy

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{矛盾|むじゅん}→矛盾：05215_mujun⟧: contradiction (stronger — implies logical impossibility)
- ⟦{相違|そうい}→相違：04043_soui⟧: difference (formal/written; neutral, not implying something is wrong)
- ⟦ずれ→ずれ：10044_zure⟧: gap, misalignment (often for timing or positioning)
